########################################
#
# Script contains analysis to compute retention of reads throughout the different
# LongAIRR processing steps determined by the summary.tsv generated during
# LongAIRR processing for each dataset.
#
# We compare S1_ONT_Q10, S1_ONT_Q17, S1_PB_Q17, S1_ONT_Q17_duplex,
# S4_ONT_Q17_HD and ONT_R9_longAIRR to give an comprehensive overview
# across seq. techs (ONT vs Pacbio) and filter strategies (simplex+duplex vs duplex_only)
# and ONT R10 vs ONT R9 pore chemistry
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. 2e
#
########################################


```{r libraries, include=TRUE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
```

--------------------2_E-----------------------
-----LongAIRR read retention across modalities

Sample information

`total_in_override` is used for the duplex-only run because its summary starts
with the duplex subset, while Figure 2e should show retention relative to all
S1_ONT input reads.

```{r}

```

Read the new LongAIRR summary structure and extract the six stages shown in
Figure 2e.

```{r}
read_summary_visium <- function(file, samplename,
                                keep_branch = c("both", "TCR", "Ig"),
                                total_in_override = NA_real_) {
  keep_branch <- match.arg(keep_branch)

  raw <- read_delim(file, delim = "\t", skip = 2, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(across(c(Step, PathInfo, InputDescription, OutputDescription), str_squish),
      Step = str_remove(Step, "^>"),
      InputReads = as.numeric(InputReads),
      OutputReads = as.numeric(OutputReads))

  filtering <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "Filtering") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  consensus <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "Collapse", PathInfo == "Consensus") %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
  
  # add TOTAL_IN (necessary for duplex run)
  total_in <- if (is.na(total_in_override)) {
    filtering$InputReads
  } else {
    total_in_override
  }

  # Shared line for input and filter steps
  shared <- tibble(Step = c("Total_in", "Filter_out", "Group_sets"), PathInfo = NA_character_,
    OutputReads = c(total_in, filtering$OutputReads, consensus$OutputReads))

  seqtag <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "Seqtag", PathInfo %in% c("Ig", "TCR")) %>%
    transmute(Step = "Seqtag_out", PathInfo, OutputReads)

  airr_out <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRR", PathInfo %in% c("Ig", "TCR"),
      str_detect(OutputDescription, regex("^Sequences with valid V\\(D\\)J annotation$", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
    transmute(Step = "AIRR_out", PathInfo, OutputReads)

  airr_prod <- raw %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRRRate", PathInfo %in% c("Ig", "TCR")) %>%
    transmute(Step = "AIRR_prod", PathInfo, OutputReads)

  branches <- bind_rows(seqtag, airr_out, airr_prod)

  if (keep_branch != "both") {
    branches <- branches %>%
      filter(PathInfo == keep_branch)
  }

  bind_rows(shared, branches) %>%
    mutate(sample = samplename,
           sample_receptor = case_when(
           PathInfo == "TCR" ~ paste0(sample, "_TCR"),
           PathInfo == "Ig"  ~ paste0(sample, "_BCR"),
           TRUE              ~ paste0(sample, "_shared")))
}
```

Create one normalized count table for both the figure and main-text table.

```{r}
steps_levels <- c("Total_in", "Filter_out", "Group_sets", "Seqtag_out", "AIRR_out", "AIRR_prod")

df_visium <- samples %>%
  select(sample, summary_tsv, keep_branch, total_in_override) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(sample, summary_tsv, keep_branch, total_in_override) {
    read_summary_visium(file = summary_tsv, samplename = sample, keep_branch = keep_branch, total_in_override = total_in_override)}) %>%
  mutate(Step = factor(Step, levels = steps_levels),
         sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_list))
```

Prepare the plot data. The consensus count is duplicated only for the receptor
branches present in each sample so that both locus-specific lines begin at the
same consensus value.

```{r}
consensus_rows <- df_visium %>%
  filter(Step == "Group_sets") %>%
  select(-PathInfo, -sample_receptor)

sample_branches <- df_visium %>%
  filter(Step == "Seqtag_out") %>%
  distinct(sample, PathInfo)

# lines are split into BCR / TCR
consensus_branches <- consensus_rows %>%
  inner_join(sample_branches, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(sample_receptor = if_else(
        PathInfo == "TCR",
        paste0(sample, "_TCR"),
        paste0(sample, "_BCR")))

df_visium_plot <- df_visium %>%
  filter(Step != "Group_sets") %>%
  bind_rows(consensus_branches) %>%
  mutate(receptor = case_when(
                    PathInfo == "TCR" ~ "TCR",
                    PathInfo == "Ig"  ~ "BCR",
                    TRUE              ~ "Shared"),
        is_shared = Step %in% c("Total_in", "Filter_out", "Group_sets"),
        is_post = Step %in% c("Group_sets", "Seqtag_out", "AIRR_out", "AIRR_prod"))

head(df_visium_plot)
```

Retention figure

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=2.8}
# Positions for the line-type key
key_x0 <- 1
key_y0 <- min(df_visium_plot$OutputReads, na.rm = TRUE) * 40

receptor_key <- tibble(
  x1    = key_x0,
  x2    = key_x0 + 0.46,
  x_lab = key_x0 + 0.50,
  y     = key_y0 * c(0.95, 0.3, 0.1),
  label = c("Shared processing", "BCR only", "TCR only"),
  lty   = c("solid", "longdash", "dotted"),
  lwd   = c(1.75, 1, 1))

step_labels <- c(
  Total_in   = "Total_in",
  Filter_out = "Filter_out",
  Group_sets = "Group_sets",
  Seqtag_out = "Seqtag_out",
  AIRR_out   = "AIRR_out",
  AIRR_prod  = "AIRR_prod")

spatial_retention <- ggplot(df_visium_plot,
  aes(Step, OutputReads, group = sample_receptor)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey65") +
  geom_line(data = df_visium_plot %>%
            filter(is_shared) %>%
            mutate(group_shared = sample), aes(color = sample, group = group_shared), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_line(data = df_visium_plot %>% filter(is_post), aes(color = sample, linetype = receptor), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sample), size = 1.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = "Raw reads", vjust = 1.3, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 4.5, y = Inf, label = "Consensus sequences", vjust = 1.3, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  #annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = "Raw reads", vjust = 1.3, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  #annotate("text", x = 4.5, y = Inf, label = "Consensus sequences", vjust = 1.3, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  geom_label(data = tibble(x = 3.5, y = 2000000.15, label = "Split by locus"),
             aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.6, hjust = 0, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.10, "lines")) +
  #geom_label(data = tibble(x = 3.5, y = 2000000.15, label = "Split by locus"),
  #           aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.5, hjust = 0, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.10, "lines")) +
  geom_segment(data = receptor_key, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = receptor_key$lwd * 0.65, linetype = receptor_key$lty, colour = "black") +
  geom_label(data = receptor_key, aes(x = x_lab, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 2.6, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0,
    label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.12, "lines")) +
  #geom_label(data = receptor_key, aes(x = x_lab, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 3, fill = "gray91", label.size = 0,
  #  label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.12, "lines")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = step_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_cols) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(BCR = "longdash", TCR = "dotted")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1), breaks = scales::log_breaks(n = 11), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
  guides(linetype = "none", color = guide_legend(nrow = 6, byrow = TRUE)) +
  labs(y = "Sequence count", x = NULL, color = "Sample") +
  theme_panel2_main +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black", lineheight = 0.9),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 0)
  )

```

----------------------
--- Main-text table
----------------------

The table mirrors the six stages shown on the Figure 2e x-axis. Shared input,
filtered-read and consensus counts are repeated across BCR and TCR rows for
clarity.

```{r}
shared_counts <- df_visium %>%
  filter(Step %in% c("Total_in", "Filter_out", "Group_sets")) %>%
  select(sample, Step, OutputReads) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Step, values_from = OutputReads)

branch_counts <- df_visium %>%
  filter(
    PathInfo %in% c("Ig", "TCR"),
    Step %in% c("Seqtag_out", "AIRR_out", "AIRR_prod")
  ) %>%
  select(sample, PathInfo, Step, OutputReads) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Step, values_from = OutputReads)

table_main_text_numeric <- branch_counts %>%
  left_join(shared_counts, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    locus_order = if_else(PathInfo == "Ig", 1L, 2L),
    PathInfo = recode(PathInfo, Ig = "BCR")
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, locus_order) %>%
 transmute(
 Dataset = as.character(sample),
 Locus = PathInfo,
 `Input reads` = Total_in,
 `Quality-filtered reads` = Filter_out,
 `UMI-SPBC consensus` = Group_sets,
 `BCR/TCR tagged` = Seqtag_out,
 `V(D)J annotated` = AIRR_out,
 `Productive AIRR` = AIRR_prod
 )

table_main_text <- table_main_text_numeric %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(Dataset, Locus),
      ~ scales::comma(.x, accuracy = 1)
    )
  )

table_main_text
```
